invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of postWrite, which is expected to produce a non-null List<WriteStatus>.
The method accesses keys in downstream table.delete and expects a non-null argument.
instantTime is passed to preWrite and table.delete and likely cannot be null.
Each key at most produces one WriteStatus to delete, so number of statuses cannot exceed number of keys.
If there are any delete results, there must have been input keys to delete.
